text.tspan: Mean income or consumption per day: 2011 vs. 2017 international-$ 2023
This data is adjusted for inflation and differences in living costs between countries.
Mean (international-$ in 2011 prices; plotted on a logarithmic axis)

tspan.tspan: World Bank Poverty and Inequality Platform (2024)
Depending on the country and year, the data relates to income (measured after taxes and benefits) or to consumption, per capita.

text.tspan: Following an update, World Bank PIP now uses 2021 international-$ for its poverty and inequality data available here. Where data for 2023 is
unavailable, the value from the closest year between 2018 and 2024 is shown instead.
